Alex K: Quick one — PR #4829 touches SDK JS snippets, the migration guide, and a pile of stale links. Need reviewers + a merge window before end of sprint. Docs preview currently failing linkcheck, any volunteers?
Maria P: I can take the SDK snippets. pinging @Jon S for the migration guide. :hand: 
Jon S: I can do the migration guide, but FYI the preview build timed out for me earlier. Error was: `Error: preview build failed: linkcheck timeout`
Sophie L: I can tackle the link fixes and do a quick pass. I have a customer call at 15:00 though, so can merge after 16:00 if everything else is green. :clock3: 
DocsBot: preview build queued for PR #4829 — status: failed (linkcheck). Details: https://ci.local/redwood/pr/4829
Alex K: Thanks. If Maria + Jon + Sophie land their parts I can do final merge + changelog bump. Maria, can you be primary on SDK snippet QA? Need a second reviewer for the JS snippet examples.
Maria P: I can be primary. Sophie, can you be backup reviewer for the snippet that touches auth example?
Sophie L: Yup I can be backup for auth snippet.
Jon S: Which files specifically? I'll scope migration guide changes.
Alex K: Paths: `docs/sdk/js/snippets/*`, `docs/migration/v1-to-v2.md`, `docs/ops/linkmap.md`. Also a couple of broken links in `docs/guides/`
Maria P: I'll leave inline comments on the snippet PR. Suggest adding a minimal async example for the new client (see below).
Maria P: ```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'rw-small', prompt: 'hello' });
console.log(res.text);
```
Sophie L: Running linkcheck locally: `npm run docs:linkcheck -- --max-tries=2`. Found 3 bad links (internal anchors). Pushing a branch with fixes now.
Sophie L: pushed alex/docs-pr-4829-fixes — fixed anchors in guides, updated two external links to canonical pages.
DocsBot: preview build started for PR #4829 (run id 74321).
DocsBot: preview build succeeded for PR #4829 — all checks green.
Maria P: LGTM from me. Left a tiny nit about example spacing. :thumbsup: 
Jon S: LGTM, small nit (suggest rewording "deprecated" section).
Sophie L: Approved.
Alex K: Merged PR #4829 and backported critical link fixes to v1 branch. Thanks everyone! :tada:
